correctness.rationale: The exact multiplier E_T(y)=T h(T(lambda+a(y)-iy)) has a regular zero expansion and residue-one poles at the nonzero imaginary 2pi lattice. Rescaling xi=Ty and epsilon=T^(1-alpha) yields uniform complex Lorentzian profiles for every fixed alias. A compactness argument excludes off-alias frequencies; the inequality |1-e^(-u+i xi)| >=1-e^(-u) and positive two-sided high-frequency damping give a uniformly vanishing high-alias tail. The limiting heights are maximized only at first aliases with minimal directional damping, which proves sharp full-step norm and near-maximizer localization. The standalone tests passed 168 finite diagnostics but do not establish generality.
